title: Ring Light, Four Dollars
subject: filming a sponsored post while broke
caption: Post-hyperpop indie, digital maximalism. Clipped drums with the transients squared off, pitched vocal stacks used as pads, granular chops of the lead vocal as a melodic instrument, bass distorted until it reads as a guitar, deliberate mp3 artifacting left audible on the pre-chorus. Pitched-up layered female lead answered by one completely dry unprocessed take. 145 BPM, E minor. Bright, panicked, forced cheerfulness. No clean mastering, no tropical house, no sad-girl piano, no four on the floor.
lyrics:
[Intro - clipped drums, pitched vocal stack]

[Chorus]
Ring light on, four dollars in
Ring light on, four dollars in
Tell them how I did it, I'll tell them how I did it
Ring light on, four dollars in

[Verse 1]
Shot the protein one in the stairwell cause the kitchen's got my roommate
Caption says consistency, my hands are shaking from the coffee
Brand paid in product, product is a tub
Tub is on the shelf behind me in every single video

[Chorus]
Ring light on, four dollars in
Ring light on, four dollars in
Tell them how I did it, I'll tell them how I did it
Ring light on, three dollars in

[Instrumental Break - granular vocal chop]

[Verse 2]
Bank app opens with my face, which feels like a joke somebody wrote
Sixty thousand people watched me say I'm doing great
One of them was my landlord
He hearted it

[Outro - artifacts, cut]
[Song ends abruptly]
